ranked.headline: Generative and graph models infer cell states and gene structure from omics data
ranked.summary: New generative and graph-based methods integrate unpaired omics and benchmark single-cell and spatial inference tasks in late 2025.

ranked.headline: Probing internal representations of biological models to steer design and diagnose bias
ranked.summary: Biological foundation models are now being inspected via sparse autoencoders, layer probing, and explanation methods, exposing confounders and motif bias.

ranked.headline: Auditing genomic deep learning models for confounders, motif bias and leakage
ranked.summary: Genomic and protein deep learning models are now being evaluated for what they learn, not only for headline accuracy.

ranked.headline: Callable-loci and repeat-aware tools reformulate population-genetic and variant analyses
ranked.summary: Recent tools extend variant calling, tandem repeat genotyping, and selection inference to callable-site and repeat-aware formulations.

ranked.headline: Taxonomic tree priors and compositional models refine microbiome data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method pair prior biological structure with microbiome modeling for differential abundance, augmentation, and prediction.

ranked.headline: Pretrained embeddings drive deep models of enzyme kinetics and ligand binding
ranked.summary: Modification-aware benchmarks and alternative input representations now test whether learned models generalize beyond standard data.

ranked.headline: Mechanical loading and stress inference coupled to multiscale tissue models
ranked.summary: Physics-based models now connect measured forces and molecular kinetics to tissue-scale outcomes across epithelia, tumors and valves.

ranked.headline: Parallel and out-of-core tools accelerate genomic and single-cell data processing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report multithreaded, GPU, and out-of-core implementations of routine genomic processing steps with stated speedups.

ranked.headline: Spatial multi-omics resolves prognostic tumor niches and cell-state heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Spatially resolved multi-omics and imaging integration now link transcriptomic states to tumor niches, morphology, and outcome.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and adapting omics methods for depth, batch, and sequencing-error limits
ranked.summary: Sequencing-based assays from cfDNA, FFPE, and long reads demand revised computational pipelines as data depth, quality, and ancestry coverage vary.

ranked.headline: Fitted brain and language models are scored against independent neural recordings
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test fitted LLMs and whole-brain models against independent MEG/EEG and EEG recordings, probing shared computational structure.

ranked.headline: Integrated omics frameworks prioritize biomarkers and candidate disease genes
ranked.summary: Integrative omics frameworks now combine transcriptomic, proteomic and network data to nominate biomarker panels and candidate genes.

ranked.headline: Reduced dynamical models of cell size, actin networks, and gene expression bursting
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply reduced stochastic and ODE models to cell size control, actin network selection, gene regulation, and fungal nuclear division dynamics.

ranked.headline: Computational methods recover protein information from mixed or compositional data
ranked.summary: Compositional transforms and robust statistical models are applied to proteomic measurements for deconvolution, outlier detection, and disease prediction.

ranked.headline: Parameter inference and identifiability in mechanistic biological models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications address identifiability, stochastic simulation, and inference for mechanistic reaction and microbial models.

ranked.headline: Calibrated fine-mapping and regulatory variant prioritization refine GWAS inference
ranked.summary: Recent work extends fine-mapping, regulatory prioritization and rare-variant testing to missingness, multitrait and calibration problems in GWAS.

ranked.headline: Structure tools tested for dimers, flexibility, interfaces, fold switching, and ddG
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers report method-specific limits, such as AlphaFold homodimer false positives, motivating explicit reporting of tool choices.

ranked.headline: k-mer and compressed index methods speed taxonomic and plasmid sequence classification
ranked.summary: Recent tools report large speed and space gains for 16S, barcode, and plasmid sequence classification, alongside new benchmark evaluations.

ranked.headline: Graph and language models encode network context to predict omics perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Encoding network, neighborhood, or knowledge structure lets models capture perturbation propagation and pathway activity from omics data.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve parental, chromosomal and fetal genetic contributions
ranked.summary: Recent tools quantify genome structure and inheritance from VCF genotypes, optical maps and case-parent triad data.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings reveal structure, function, and homology from sequence
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein language model representations are now probed, pooled, and discretized to infer structure and function from sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Quantifying topology, calibration, and model uncertainty in phylogenetic inference
ranked.summary: Assumptions and support values in phylogenetic and phylodynamic inference are now tested explicitly rather than taken as given.

ranked.headline: Open computational platforms for metabolic flux and microbial interaction modeling
ranked.summary: Flux and genome-scale metabolic models are now packaged as open, interoperable tools spanning microbial interactions and nonstationary 13C analysis.

ranked.headline: Language models predict trial, cancer and chronic disease outcomes from biomedical data
ranked.summary: Language-model feature engineering and pretrained transformers now extend outcome prediction to trial registries, oncology records and plasma metabolomics.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for population genetics, pangenome graphs, and sequence classification
ranked.summary: Recent releases package quality control, ancestry inference, pangenome graph manipulation, and read processing into accessible command-line and Python tools.

ranked.headline: Linkage, biophysical stability and weak selection shape mutation fitness inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published HIV study apply quantitative mutation-level models to genome- and population-scale evolutionary outcomes.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies resolve introgression and hybrid genome history
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies now link introgression to chromosome structure and hybrid genome history in birds, lizards, and flies.

ranked.headline: Tracking individual cells and lineages across time-lapse imaging and atlas data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair deep learning and optimal transport with live imaging to follow single cells and lineages over time.

ranked.headline: Generative models steered toward target properties for peptides, codons, and enzymes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints impose explicit design objectives on generative models for antimicrobial peptides, codons, and enzymes.

ranked.headline: LLMs Benchmarked for Microbial Traits, Variant Triage and Pipeline Generation
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether general LLMs can autonomously handle phenotype annotation, variant interpretation, and pipeline construction.

ranked.headline: Network and contrastive methods infer microbe-drug, drug-drug and multi-omics links
ranked.summary: Recent publications apply network random walks, contrastive learning and Bayesian structural models to drug, microbe and multi-omics prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models link spatial, omics, and imaging profiles to cancer outcomes
ranked.summary: Interpretable deep models now map spatial proteomics, lesion geometry, and multi-omics profiles to mutation, survival, and therapy-response predictions.

ranked.headline: Non-model animal genome assemblies are being paired with gene-level annotation
ranked.summary: Recent HiFi, Omni-C and draft assemblies report BUSCO completeness alongside annotated gene content for non-model species.

ranked.headline: Deep learning extracts molecular structure from single-molecule and cryo-EM images
ranked.summary: Pretrained and geometric deep learning models now register, average, and classify structural data across cryo-EM, SMLM, and AFM modalities.

ranked.headline: Gene circuit control via optogenetics, pattern switching and neuromorphic design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply reinforcement learning and amplitude-equation control to gene circuits and bioprocesses.

ranked.headline: Diffusion models sample protein conformations and probe learned energetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend diffusion-based generative models to conformational ensembles, energy readouts, and transition paths.

ranked.headline: Scalable graph, haplotype and lineage inference across large genomic datasets
ranked.summary: Pangenome graphs, PBWT indices and single-cell lineage data now support haplotype-resolved inference at population and single-cell scale.

ranked.headline: Lipids, ligands and glycans reshape protein conformational energetics and dynamics
ranked.summary: MD and steered MD studies across six systems probe how membranes, ligands and glycans shift protein energy landscapes and dynamics.

ranked.headline: Generative and optimization-based RNA design now targets 3D and pseudoknotted folds
ranked.summary: Structure-conditioned generative models and blinded Eterna validation push RNA design toward tertiary folds.

ranked.headline: AI frameworks extend de novo design to antibodies, proteins, and small-molecule hits
ranked.summary: Late-2025 preprints and a PLOS Computational Biology paper report modular AI design frameworks spanning proteins, antibodies, and small molecules.
